audience: field service businesses such as trades companies that quote, schedule and invoice jobs in Ascora

useCases.title: Find quotes that wait for a customer answer
useCases.text: List the open quotes with their status and totals. Then open one quote by its number to read its dates, customers and job type.

useCases.title: Check completed jobs before invoicing
useCases.text: List the jobs by status. Then read the labour lines and timesheet entries of one job.

useCases.title: See who is booked on the schedule
useCases.text: Search the schedule for bookings of jobs, quotes and activities. Open one booking to read its staff member, times and address.

useCases.title: Build a quote from the price list
useCases.text: Find supplies and labour roles in the price list, and find the site customer. Then create a quote with those items. The quote stays in progress and is not sent to the customer.

useCases.title: Add a new customer or enquiry with a note
useCases.text: Search the customers first to avoid duplicates. Then create the customer or enquiry, and add a note with the context.

useCases.title: Win a quote and book staff on the job
useCases.text: Set a quote to won, which creates its job. Then create a booking to schedule staff on that job.
